definitions: An abbreviation for 'Internet Printing Protocol', a protocol for printing documents over the internet.
An abbreviation for 'Individual Performance Plan', a document used in performance management to set goals and track progress for an individual employee.
An abbreviation for 'Integrated Project Plan', a comprehensive plan that integrates all aspects of a project, including scope, schedule, cost, and resources.
examples: The team developed an IPP for the new product launch.
